data.concept: Stack push operation with array implementation
evidence: In push(), the student writes `stack[top] = value;` before `top++;`, causing the first push to write to stack[-1] (out-of-bounds) since top starts at -1
The order is reversed: it should be `top++;` then `stack[top] = value;` (or `stack[++top] = value;`) so that top is incremented before the assignment
The overflow check `if (top == MAX)` is also incorrect — it should be `top == MAX - 1` since valid indices are 0 through MAX-1
data.invariant: top must point to the next available slot before writing, so increment must happen before array assignment
